findings.description: When the camera racks focus to the smartphone screen, the interface displays nonsensical, malformed characters and symbols (such as '7.4Z', 'A A' with random horizontal bars, 'A7.42', and 'AZ - 12') rather than a coherent interface or legible text.

As the person tilts the phone between 00:08 and 00:09, the 'A A' text at the top of the screen slides sideways toward the left corner on its own, and the central 'A7.42' text warps and morphs into jagged, illegible scribbles.
